summary: Iteration 16 — Refactor split of server.py: posts + messages routes moved to /app/backend/routes/posts.py and /app/backend/routes/messages.py via register_*_routes(api_router, db, get_current_user, notify) pattern. Pure refactor, strict behavior preservation. 29/29 new pytest cases pass + 36/36 prior regression tests (iter14/iter15) still green. No functional regression detected on posts, messages, ads rate-limit, admin/deals, admin/ads, external-offers/keyless, /upload (mp4/webm/mov/docx/xlsx/pptx/png), /auth/login, /messages-rt (still inline in server.py).
critical_code_review_comments: DUPLICATION — Pydantic models PostIn/PostMedia/LinkPreview/CommentIn/MessageIn/MessageAttachment are now defined BOTH in /app/backend/server.py (used by inline /messages-rt) AND in /app/backend/routes/{posts,messages}.py. If a field is added to one copy the other will silently drift. Recommend: keep models in one place (either a /app/backend/models.py shared module imported by both server.py and routes/*) and remove the duplicates.

REFACTOR INCONSISTENCY — The new routers register on `ads_api` (the APIRouter created for ads, named after the ads domain). Naming is now misleading because /api/posts and /api/messages share the same router as /api/ads/*. Suggest renaming `ads_api` to `extra_api` or `feature_api`, or create one APIRouter per feature module and include each separately.

server.py is still ~4000 lines. Refactor is good start; continue extracting /api/auth, /api/users, /api/offers, /api/applications, /api/deals, /api/notifications into their own routes/*.py files using the same register_*_routes pattern to reach <700 lines per file (project guideline).

Tests under /app/backend/tests/ depend on REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL being present in the shell environment. The newer test files (iter15, iter14, iter16-new) silently fall back to None, leading to collection errors when run by plain `pytest backend/tests/`. Recommend a conftest.py at /app/backend/tests/conftest.py that loads /app/frontend/.env once via python-dotenv to make every suite portable.
routes/messages.py send_message — `last_message` ternary still uses ambiguous precedence (carryover from iter15 note). Same minor clarity issue.
